topics.title: Howard Explains Fox TV to Gordon Elliott
topics.summary: During a segment with Fox TV host Gordon Elliott, Howard Stern discusses his frustrations with the network’s restrictions on content and attire, particularly regarding signs referencing Rupert Murdoch. He attempts to negotiate allowing displays of criticism while avoiding potential job loss due to Murdoch's influence.

topics.title: Howard Stern & Fox Television Disputes
topics.summary: During a chaotic broadcast, Howard Stern repeatedly challenges Fox Television’s restrictions on his commentary while discussing the potential lawsuit against them. He makes light of their concerns and frequently interrupts himself with tangents about personal matters like hair styling and past relationships, ultimately leading to an attempt to interview Gordon Elliott live.

topics.title: Technical Difficulties and Host Frustration
topics.summary: During a broadcast segment plagued by audio issues and production delays, hosts repeatedly struggle to engage viewers via phone calls while expressing frustration over technical difficulties and perceived manipulation. They speculate about their future on the show amidst ongoing problems with file footage and inconsistent scheduling.

topics.title: Radio Show Technical Difficulties & Host Frustration
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard repeatedly expresses frustration as technical issues plague the show. Fox television interference is blamed for interruptions including yakety-yak music over him while he attempts an interview and his technicians struggle to resolve audio problems leading to a premature end of the segment.

topics.title: Kreskin and Fox Television's Chaotic Interview
topics.summary: During a radio interview with Kreskin, discussions arise about production issues at Fox Television, including camera setups and concerns regarding executives like Rupert Murdoch. The conversation becomes chaotic as the hosts attempt to influence viewers through predictions while interacting with Robin, culminating in an awkward exchange involving shaking hands.

topics.title: Mind Reading Card Experiment
topics.summary: Kreskin conducts an experiment with Robin Cervantes, guiding her to mentally select a card from a shuffled deck by drawing a circle and naming a number. He reveals that she correctly identified the fifth card – the three of hearts – in the spread after he placed it on the table.
